why: Lets foreign financial service providers get Israeli licence with relief based on foreign regulation: recognition of foreign licences.
Widens work grant eligibility to purchase-group land owners treated as owning a single home.
Allows the prime minister to appoint two deputy ministers in any government; strengthens alternate government.
Tightens sports coach certification: graded levels, criminal-record bar, state exams, recognition of training institutions.
Adds a licence condition for private manpower bureaus: no ties to nursing companies.
Removes mandatory instructor presence for adult trainees in fitness centres; operating rule rather than occupational entry.
Bars credit card companies from holding insurance agency licences, tightening who may enter the trade.
Lets criminal courts issue protective orders for victims at the end of criminal proceedings.
Widens self-defence for home, property and farm defenders, narrowing liability; tough-on-crime intent, not penalties for offenders.
Adds first bar exam part after first year as precondition for internship: earlier screening of lawyers.
Moves expulsion and disqualification to a judge with Supreme Court approval, only clear-cut cases: harder to exclude.
Allows public officials to accept donations for legal or medical costs, relaxing gift rules despite reporting duties.
Extends deadline allowing unpermitted homes, mainly Arab localities, to connect to electricity, water and telephone.
